meanings.usage: 修饰物或事，表示令人害怕
指对鱼类进行过度捕获
保护性结构，可作名词或动词

meanings.meaning: cage 也可用作动词表示把...关进笼子

meanings.usage: 指体型巨大或可怕的生物
the absence of something 表示某物的缺失
常与throw连用，表示扔到船外
常与into连用，表示撞上某人或某物
可表示体型变大或植物生长

phrases.usage: 炸鱼薯条，英国经典快餐

examples.en: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain.
examples.zh: 炸鱼薯条一直是英国人最喜爱的菜肴。

phrases.usage: 吓得魂不附体；不知所措

examples.en: Divers have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish.
examples.zh: 潜水员们被巨大的鱼吓得魂不附体。

examples.en: Giant fish are bumping into divers as they work.
examples.zh: 巨鱼在潜水员工作时撞到他们。

examples.en: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers.
examples.zh: 因此，听说巨鱼令潜水员们恐惧是令人惊讶的。

phrases.usage: 让某事被做（由他人完成）

examples.en: They have had special cages made to protect them.
examples.zh: 他们让人制作了特殊的笼子来保护他们。

examples.en: The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties.
examples.zh: 这些鱼不是鲨鱼或虎鲸，而是人们喜爱的食用品种。

examples.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow.
examples.zh: 结果，这些鱼只是不停地吃，不停地长大。

examples.en: They grow to unnatural sizes, sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
examples.zh: 它们长到不正常的尺寸，有时可达十二英尺长。

examples.en: Divers often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water.
examples.zh: 潜水员经常需要在水下百尺的黑暗中工作。

examples.en: The warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea causes fish to grow.
examples.zh: 海底热油管周围的温暖海水导致鱼长大。

phrases.usage: /ɔɪl rɪɡ/ noun. 石油钻井平台（用于海上开采石油的结构）

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing
grammar.definition: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在并可能继续下去的动作，强调动作的持续性 用于描述一个持续进行的动作，常与all + 时间段或for/since连用

examples.en: Fish has become more and more expensive as the oceans have been overfished.
examples.zh: 由于海洋被过度捕捞，鱼变得越来越贵。

examples.en: Divers have been frightened out of their wits.
examples.zh: 潜水员们一直被吓得魂不附体。

grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示一个已完成的动作对现在造成的影响，动作的承受者作为主语 强调动作的承受者而非执行者

examples.en: Special cages have been made to protect them.
examples.zh: 特殊笼子已被制作来保护他们。

grammar.title: 因果关系表达 (Cause and Effect)
grammar.structure: 原因（名词短语/从句）+ cause/lead to/result in + 结果
grammar.definition: 用不同方式表达原因和结果 用于说明某事发生的原因及其后果

examples.en: Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large.
examples.zh: 三个因素导致这些鱼长得如此巨大。

examples.en: The warm water causes fish to grow large.
examples.zh: 温暖的海水导致鱼长大。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing（现在完成进行时）

original.en: Divers have been frightened out of their wits.
original.zh: 潜水员们一直被吓得魂不附体。

imitations.en: She has been working on this project for months.
imitations.zh: 她已经在这个项目上工作了几个月。

imitations.en: It has been raining all day.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has + been + 过去分词（现在完成时的被动语态）

imitations.en: Many animals have been protected by law.
imitations.zh: 许多动物已被法律保护。

original.en: The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties.
original.zh: 这些鱼不是鲨鱼或虎鲸，而是人们喜爱的食用品种。

imitations.en: He is not a teacher, but a doctor.
The problem is not money but time.

original.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow.
original.zh: 结果，这些鱼只是不停地吃，不停地长大。

imitations.en: He didn't study. As a result, he failed the exam.
imitations.zh: 他没有学习。结果，他考试不及格。

imitations.en: It rained heavily. As a result, the game was cancelled.
imitations.zh: 雨下得很大。结果，比赛被取消了。

lines.en: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain, but as the oceans have been overfished, fish has become more and more expensive.
lines.zh: 油煎鱼加炸土豆片一直是英国人喜爱的一道菜，但是随着海洋里的滥捕滥捞，鱼已经变得越来越昂贵。

lines.en: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on North Sea oil rigs.
lines.zh: 因此，听说北海石油钻井平台上的潜水员受到巨型鱼类的恐吓，确实很让人吃惊。

lines.en: Oil rigs have to be repaired frequently and divers, who often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water, have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish bumping into them as they work.
lines.zh: 钻井平台需要经常修理，潜水员常常要在水面100英尺以下摸黑工作，他们曾在工作时被撞到他们身上的大鱼吓得惊惶失措。

lines.en: Now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters.
lines.zh: 现在他们有了特制的笼子，用来保护他们免受大鱼的侵袭。

lines.en: The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties like cod and skate which grow to unnatural sizes, sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
lines.zh: 这些鱼并不是鲨鱼或逆戟鲸，而是深受人们喜爱的食用鱼品种，如鳕鱼和鳐鱼，只不过它们长得出奇地大，有时长达12英尺。

lines.en: Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea; the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs; the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs.
lines.zh: 这些鱼能长得这么大是由3个因素造成的：海底热的输油管道附近的温暖的海水；钻井平台工作人员抛到海里充足的食物；钻井平台周围根本没有捕鱼船只。

lines.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow in the lovely warm water.
lines.zh: 结果是，这些鱼就在可爱的温暖的水流中吃呀吃，长呀长。

questions.q: What kind of fish are they?
questions.a: They are favourite eating varieties like cod and skate, which grow to unnatural sizes.
questions.aZh: 它们是像鳕鱼和鳐鱼那样深受人们喜爱的食用鱼品种，只不过长得异常巨大。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第5句：The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties...

questions.q: Why have the divers been frightened out of their wits?
questions.zh: 潜水员们为什么被吓得惊慌失措？
questions.a: Because giant fish bump into them as they work in darkness under water.
questions.aZh: 因为他们在水下黑暗中工作时，巨型鱼类会撞到他们身上。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第3句，注意 bumping into them as they work。

questions.q: What have the divers now had made to protect themselves?
questions.zh: 潜水员们现在请人做了什么来保护自己？
questions.a: They have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters.
questions.aZh: 他们请人做了特制的笼子，保护自己免受这些庞然大物的侵袭。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第4句，注意 have had...made 使役结构。

questions.q: What three factors have caused these fish to grow so large?
questions.zh: 是哪三个因素使这些鱼长得这么大？
questions.a: The warm water round the hot oil pipes, the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews, and the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs.
questions.aZh: 海底热油管周围的温水、船员抛到海里的大量食物，以及钻井平台周围没有捕鱼船只。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第6句，作者用 Three factors have caused... 逐条列出。

questions.q: Why does the writer end the text with the question "Who eats who?"?
questions.zh: 作者为什么用“究竟谁吃谁呢？”来结尾？
questions.a: To show the surprising reversal: the fish people usually eat have grown so big that they now scare or threaten the divers, so it seems the fish may eat man.
questions.aZh: 为了点出这种反差：人们通常吃的鱼如今长得太大，反倒能威胁到潜水员——晚餐到底谁吃谁，引人深思。
questions.hint: 结合开头 fish and chips 与最后一句的反差来思考。

translation:
油煎鱼加炸土豆片一直是英国人喜爱的一道菜，但是随着海洋里的滥捕滥捞，鱼已经变得越来越昂贵。
因此，听说北海石油钻井平台上的潜水员受到巨型鱼类的恐吓，确实很让人吃惊。
钻井平台需要经常修理，潜水员常常要在水面100英尺以下摸黑工作，他们曾在工作时被撞到他们身上的大鱼吓得惊惶失措。
现在他们有了特制的笼子，用来保护他们免受大鱼的侵袭。
这些鱼并不是鲨鱼或逆戟鲸，而是深受人们喜爱的食用鱼品种，如鳕鱼和鳐鱼，只不过它们长得出奇地大，有时长达12英尺。
这些鱼能长得这么大是由3个因素造成的：海底热的输油管道附近的温暖的海水；钻井平台工作人员抛到海里充足的食物；钻井平台周围根本没有捕鱼船只。
结果是，这些鱼就在可爱的温暖的水流中吃呀吃，长呀长。
究竟谁吃谁呢？
title: What's for supper?
subtitle: 晚餐吃什么？

lead.question: 英国人的炸鱼薯条，如今怎么会变成让北海潜水员胆战心惊的庞然大物？
lead.warmup: 说到英国人的家常晚餐，很多人会想到 fish and chips——简单、便宜又大受欢迎。但随着海洋被过度捕捞，鱼越来越贵。而在北海石油钻井平台下，潜水员们遇到一件怪事：他们常吃的鳕鱼、鳐鱼竟长得异常巨大，还把他们吓得不轻。这节课就跟着作者，一边学英语，一边看这场“谁吃谁”的晚餐谜题。
goals: 学会 fish and chips 等 and 连接的整体名词作主语时谓语用单数。
掌握 have sth done（请人做某事）的使役结构。
分清可数与不可数名词，掌握 pea、beer、fish 等的用法。
会用 be always doing 表达抱怨，并积累 diver、oil rig、unnatural 等词。
lead.summary: 课文从英国人爱吃的 fish and chips 说起：鱼越来越贵，可北海石油钻井平台下的鱼却越长越大。潜水员在黑暗中作业时常被巨型鱼类撞上，吓得惊慌失措，只好请人做了特制笼子防身。作者指出三条原因——输油管附近的温水、船员抛下的充足食物，以及周围没有渔船。最后一句“Who eats who?”点出反差，令人回味。
lead.tips: 记住 out of one's wits 必须用复数 wits；fish and chips 作整体时谓语用单数，若强调“鱼和土豆片两样东西”才可用复数。

exercises.q: 汉译英：油煎鱼加炸土豆片一直是英国人喜爱的一道菜。
exercises.a: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain.
exercises.note: 整体名词作主语用单数

exercises.q: 句型转换：They have made special cages to protect the divers from these monsters.（用 have sth done 结构改写）
exercises.a: They have had special cages made to protect the divers from these monsters.
exercises.note: have sth done 表请人做

exercises.q: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：Fish and chips ____ (be) a favourite dish in Britain; as the oceans have been overfished, fish ____ (have) become more and more expensive.
exercises.note: 整体用单数；fish 鱼肉不可数

exercises.q: 改错（一处）：The divers have been frightened out of their wit by giant fish bumping into them.
exercises.note: out of one's wits 用复数

exercises.q: 汉译英（用 be always doing 表抱怨）：钻井平台上的船员总是在把食物抛到海里。
exercises.a: The crews on the rigs are always throwing food overboard.

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：For supper we had fish and chips, some ____ (pea) and a bottle of ____ (beer).
exercises.note: pea 可数用复数；beer 不可数

exercises.q: 改错（一处）：This coat will protect you of the cold.

quiz.q: “油煎鱼加炸土豆片”用英语怎么说？
课文中潜水员被什么吓得惊慌失措？
quiz.note: 不是鲨鱼或逆戟鲸，而是巨型鱼类

quiz.q: Fish and chips ____ a favourite dish in Britain. 横线处应填？
quiz.note: 整体名词作主语用单数

quiz.q: 下列哪个词是不可数名词？
“他们请人做了特制的笼子。”应译为？
options: They have had special cages made.
quiz.note: 用 have sth done 结构

quiz.q: 用 be always doing 表抱怨，“巨型鱼类总是撞到潜水员”最恰当的是？
options: Giant fish always bump into the divers.
Giant fish are always bumping into the divers.
Giant fish are always bumped into the divers.
Giant fish have always bump into the divers.
quiz.note: be always doing 表反复且带抱怨
